audience.summary: UK commercial building maintenance and building services firms

cta.organic: Organic posts give practical value without hard selling. Don't push the CTA in every post.

brand.imagery: Realistic UK commercial maintenance imagery: plant rooms, rooftops, risers, service vans and engineers at work. No stock-photo clichés.
brand.logoRule: Use the official Nexai logo (set in Prism’s Photo layout).

writing.voice: Write like we’re giving someone an honest update from inside Nexai. Use natural British English and first-person plural where it fits. Explain what we’re building, what prompted it, the everyday problem and the outcome we’re working towards. Give the reader something useful. Distinguish work in progress from products, results or client work we can genuinely point to. When a CTA fits, invite a comment or message in our own voice. Vary the wording. Some posts can end on the useful point.
